profile.headline: Subcontracting consultant for hire.
profile.summary:
State of the Art Information and Entertainment Systems Custom Built to your Budget and Needs. C# Software Development and Support. Customer Service R us. 

Hello!  The future of Entertainment is here, computers and HDTV have come together into some amazing solutions designed to suite your needs to a T. 

High performance Systems are Custom Built and installed when applicable. Turn your Entertainment or Computer  room into a Total Entertainment and Information System. Watch Live HDTV in a window on your computer. Pipe it to the big screen in the living room. Record Terabytes of HDTV. Prioritize your series and have much more control and storage space than any other DVR can offer. Combine your HDTV and Computer Experience, giving you more time and more options. Network your other computers to the solution and take it to any room.

Watch YouTube Videos and browse the Web or do Computer things on the other monitor. Or shrink the TV window down while you work. Finally have a System built that can meet your personal or small business needs! (Great for Gaming too!)

Computer and Entertainment Systems Designed for you! 
Custom Software By Contract, 80-100% virtual only please.
-JpE-

*These are a few of the Pages I Admin and or Created.

positions.title: CEO/CIO & Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Imagineer, Design, Develop, Program, Debug and Test Software Solutions as well as Design and Build the Hardware for Computer and Entertainment Systems to run it on when applicable. 

Custom Built SuperSystems to Suite the Needs of Clients WorldWide.

company.name: Global Access Computers and Entertainment Systems

positions.title: CIO
positions.description:
QuickBooks, Payroll, Chief of Information, Wand Data, Categorize Music and other Assets into Computer Data Base and Wand Program. Website Development and generally everything electronic and Information wise. Customer Service, Information Tech, Data Entry and programming.

This vending machine business was transitioning from doing things the old way to using the internet and computers and hand held wands. The information was of course more important than they had realized and I showed them how to collect it and use it more wisely. Tracking machines and even CDs as well as predicting revenues and projecting licensing payments.

positions.title: Master CNC Machinist, Programmer
positions.description:
Master CNC Machinist, Program, Setup, Fabricate Tooling, Molds or Jigs, CNC Machine Tools including vertical and horizontal Milling and Turning Centers. Inspect Parts and provide support to other Machinists. 

Aside from the typical military and Oceanographic work from Script's Oceanographic Institute,
We built the retrofitting applied to all Cal-Trans bridges around the turn of the century. The design we came up with and shake tested at UCSD's massive Shake Table up the hill was applied to all California Bridges and perhaps more around the world. Steel Sandwiching rubber with a lead core for dampening. The lead was 3" around and would get extruded thru a 2" hole during abnormal vertical stresses. The Stainless Steel Machines was 6" thick slabs 6' by 6' wide. I always got handed the tough jobs, be it titanium or magnesium and so on. I was always one of the few machinists who also knew metallurgy.

These machine tools were shipyard sized. I was appointed safety adviser to the shop.

positions.title: 2nd Shift Supervisor
positions.description:
2nd Shift Supervisor, CNC Master Machinist and Programmer, CMM Inspector, Lead Man.
(2nd shift while attending college)

Vertical and Horizontal Lathes and Mills, CNC or Conventional Machine Tool Program, Setup, Operate and Inspector for 2nd Shift. Fabricate Jigs, Jaws, Fixtures and Special Job Tooling. 

2nd Shift Inspector and Supervisor.

Manufacturing Aerospace, military, Bio-medical, Bio Science and Oceanographic equipment.  Top Secret Military contracts. Supervisor and CMM Inspector. (Search: X37b or Aurora Project)

These machine tools were hooked up directly to the Central Computer to send and receive digital programs.

positions.title: Master CNC Machinist
positions.description:
Program, Fabricate Special Tooling and Jigs, Setup and Operate CNC Machine Tools.

CNC Turning Centers. Conventional Machine Tools. Inspection and Prototyping and first run.

Basically we built the fueling systems used on the Space Shuttles, everything was liquid hydrogen and liquid oxygen. Lines had to be vacuum sealed and X-ray inspected Welds and so on. Precision Machined Parts of  the highest quality.

http://www.navair.navy.mil/index.cfm?fuseaction=home.NAVAIRNewsStory&id=5613

positions.title: Custom Software Developer and Head of Support
positions.description:
GBBS-Pro became such a passion for me, I eventually became the go to SysOP for the other SysOPs with problems or who wanted my MODs (modifications and additional software) and Support setting up and Operating their Apple II Bulletin Board Systems. 

This was before the WEB, we had the internet then but you had to like Telnet to a Unix Server and use UNIX commands to navigate. 

You had to setup C-Shells in SH of BASH to do your emailings and postings and to gather your files for you to automatically download. I wrote ProTERM scripts that would further automate the process and save time on my long distance bill. Later call forwarding into the TelNET node in SLO. lol

We had the Apple II computers Networked via Telephone Modems as early as 1987 and had a Network setup that roughly spanned the nation. I once did work remotely at 300 baud trans Atlantic for a GBBS setup by a Pilot Flying F15 sorties into Bagdad. It was one of the first to allow troops to email and chat with family and friends back home. I had a SysOP from as far away as Johanesburg South Africa logging into my system for support. (The ProBOARD II GBBS)

One of what I consider my most important contributions I received little for. I was thinking and thinking how neat Email was and wondering what was going to be next.  So I coined the term Fmail since E was followed by F lol.  But Fmail allowed the user to ATTACH a brief comment and send a FILE via the Email Systems. Now we simply call these "attachments".

The ProBOARD II was Sister System to the Apple Elite II and Networked with her. My system would let the new user register and give their phone number. It would then call them back at that phone number to verify. It did all kinds of cool stuff unheard of then. We had Topics or Threads for people to comment on and join in on public conversations. Email included receipts and so on. It had games like Stock Broker &Trade-wars type stuff, Online Dating, And of Course Downloads.

positions.title: ProTERM Mac Co-Designer and Developer
positions.description:
Co Designed and Developed ProTERM Mac with Dale Smith and Author Greg Schaefer and the entire Intrec Software team. 
--
My involvement with GBBS-Pro, also written by author Greg Schaefer, got me involved in ProTERM for the Apple 2. After beta testing that version for several years I was invited to join the Development Team for ProTERM Mac.

100% virtual. I had beta tested ProTERM for the Apple // and fell into Designing and Developing the Mac version for Publisher Jerry Cline @ Intrec Software.

My primary contribution other than look and feel is the macrolanguage embedded in ProTERM Mac and the resulting library of scripts therefor and so on. IMplementing Ymodem 4k and a lot of Design work in the ProTERM Editor regarding ProTERM Special Emulation that first animated graphics.

As well as getting me noticed; It was the ProTERM Mac Macros that allowed me to be part of the Team by rapidly streaming my feeds from the Support BBS and automatically sending responses and emails, even uploads and downloads automatically via the custom scripts.

positions.title: Journeyman CNC Machinist
positions.description:
Program, Setup and Operate CNC Machine Tools. Vertical & Horizontal Milling and Turning Centers, Fabricate Tooling, Devise Jigs, Fixtures and other Tooling as required. CNC Manufacturing of Aerospace and other high precision products.

These machines accepted a punched tape from which the binary code was read to produce the machine tool program in the CNC Machine Tool. A blank tape could then be punched from the machine by hooking up an extension punched tape printer with any modifications made by the machinist.

positions.title: Owner
positions.description: Having one of the first computers around I setup and operated successfully a small Secretarial and Printing Service. Specialized in Resumes and Mass Mailings. First dabling in Modems and telecom and then on into Programming with GBBS-Pro.

positions.title: Electronics Technician
positions.description:
Electronics Technician working with Engineers and Machinists Automating Electronics Manufacturing Assembly Lines in the Factory. Lead Tech for DIP Switch, Specializing in HAMs and CAMs. The automated equipment there would produce 70,000 DIP switches per 8 hour shift under my administration. 35,000 for the 2nd Shift in that same time.

Worked for the first time with little electronic boxes called computers. These were 8 bit systems with 16k of memory and a processor measured in Khz. They had no storage at first but later we developed a method using a cassette tape recorder. These were programmed in machine code and punched in using hexadecimal, thus my intro to all that as well as Binary for coding the DIP switches.  You might remember DIP switches they were used on lots of things like printers and modems back in the heyday.

In those days we used a lot of Pneumatic Valves and Hydraulics along with Electronic Sensors like the Eye that rings the bell when you walk into a store. Those kind of things revolutionized manufacturing and then things went offshore for the most part. We had built the tools and dies and molds and automated the assembly lines here first however.

positions.title: Motorcycle Mechanic
positions.description: Yamaha Motorcycle Mechanic and Go fer.

positions.title: Hired Field Hand
positions.description: Changed irrigation lines in the alfalfa fields, I'll never forget the smell of freshly harvest alfalfa and bucking hay in the barn with those 3 wire bales before I broke my back racing in 1976.

positions.title: Farm Hand
positions.description: Fed animals, milked the cow, groomed the horses, fed the chickens and culled the pigeons. Watering crops, fixing fences, patrolling for predators and building little dams in the creek. lol

projects.description: Awesome Telecom Software for the Mac!
